name: Charles Graves House

dates.note: No build date was read from a source this record cites: the Wikipedia article read gives Federal details and no date, and the marker entry's snippet says the house 'was constructed for Charles Graves, a local factor' without a year. The node's exemplar says late eighteenth century and its year is null; both are left as they stand.

refs.title: Charles Graves House - Wikipedia
refs.note: 'The interior follows the normal Charleston single house plan. There is a three-story stair hall in the center with a single room on either side ... A two-story piazza with Tuscan columns, ceiling panels, and plain balusters is on the west facade. The house has brick covered in stucco that looks like stone, a string course made of bricks, quoining, and decorative brick work that looks like dentils.' The article carries a single-source notice.
